summary: Complete independent final audit read all 195 Chinese units, all 54 temporal or active-hint items, and all 17 person records at staged commit da0888de623e7b694c6cd89d1bce2175aecf8089. Most dated eclipse and celestial-omen records have sound regnal-year conversions and owners. Four records still need correction: the Xue and Ouyang source-work labels are non-biographical, and Zhou Taizu’s contradictory 顯德三年 label must remain undated while his separately supported active-date hint is AD 952 only. Han Gaozu’s BC 196–195 context and Tang Zhuangzong’s separate AD 911 plus AD 924–925 contexts were specifically verified.

references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 四月甲午，歲犯鉤鈐。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 二年七月，熒惑犯井鉞。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 八月乙未，熒惑犯天樽。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 九月辛酉，熒惑犯鬼。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 庚辰，熒惑掩右執法。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 十月壬辰，太白犯進賢。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 三年，四月乙丑，熒惑犯靈臺。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 五月辛巳，熒惑犯上將。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 顯德六年，六月庚子，熒惑與心大星合度，光芒相射。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 先是，熒惑勾己於房、心間，凡數月，至是與心大星合度，是夜順行。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 〈（案：此條《歐陽史》不載。）〉
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: ◎星晝見唐同光三年，六月己巳，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 天成元年，七月庚申，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 長興二年，五月己亥，歲星晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 閏五月己巳，歲星晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 八月戊子，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 三年，十月壬申，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 四年，五月癸卯，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 清泰元年，五月己未，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 漢天福十三年，四月丙子，太白晝見。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 乾祐二年，四月壬午，太白晝見，
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 周廣順二年，二月庚寅，太白經天。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: ◎流星
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 梁乾化元年，十一月甲辰，東方有流星如數升器，出畢宿口，曳光三丈餘，有聲如雷。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 唐長興二年，九月丙戌夜，二鼓初，東北方有小流星入北斗魁滅。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 至五鼓初，西北方次北有流星，狀如半升器，初小後大，速流如奎滅。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 尾跡凝天，屈曲似雲而散，光明燭地。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 又東北有流星如大桃，出下臺星，西北速流，至斗柄第三星旁滅。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 五鼓後至明，中天及四方有小流星百餘，流註交橫。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 應順元年春，二月辛未夜，有大星如五升器，流於東北，有聲如雷。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 清泰元年，九月辛丑夜，五鼓初，有大星如五斗器而南流，尾跡長數丈，亦赤色，移時盤屈如龍形，蹙縮如二鏵，相鬥而散。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 又一星稍小，東流，有尾跡，凝成白氣，食頃方散。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 晉天福三年，三月壬申夜，四鼓後，東方有大流星，狀如三升器，其色白，長尺餘，屈曲流出河鼓星東三尺，流丈餘滅。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 周顯德元年，正月庚寅，子夜後，東北有大星墜，有聲如雷，牛馬震駭，六街鼓人方寐而驚，以為曉鼓，乃齊伐鼓以應之，至曙方知之。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 三月，高平之役，戰之前夕，有大流星如日，流行數丈，墜於賊營之所。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: ◎雲氣
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 梁開平二年，三月丁丑夜，月有蒼白暈，又有白氣如人形十餘，皆東向，出於暈內。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 九月乙酉，平旦，西方有氣如人形甚眾，皆若俯伏之狀，經刻乃散。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 唐同光三年，日有背氣，凡十二。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 三年，九月丁未夜，遍天陰雲，北方有聲如雷，四面雞雉皆雊，俗謂之「天狗落」。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 是歲，日有背氣，凡十三。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 是月，司天監奏：「自七月三日陰雲大雨，至九月十八日後方晴，三辰行度災祥，數日不見。」
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 閏十二月庚午，日有黑氣，似日，交相錯磨，測在室十度。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 天成二年，十二月壬辰，西方有赤氣，如火焰焰，約二千里。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 占者云「不出二年，其下當有大兵。」
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 長興三年，六月，司天監奏：「自月初至月終，每夜陰雲蔽天，不辨星月。」
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 應順元年，四月九日，白虹貫日，是時閔帝遇害。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 晉天福初，高祖將建義於太原，日傍多有五色雲，如蓮芰之狀。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 二年，正月丙辰，一鼓初，北方有赤氣，向西至戌亥地，東北至醜地已來向北，闊三丈餘，狀如火光。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 赤氣內見紫微宮共北斗諸星，其氣乍明乍暗。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 至三點後，後有白氣數條，相次西行，直至三鼓後散。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 漢乾祐二年十二月，日暈三重，上有背氣。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.

references.quote: 周顯德三年，十二月庚午，白虹貫日，氣暈勾環。
references.reason: Independent source-reading witness for complete chapter chronology coverage.
